source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of market insights (PDF 212).

blocks.text: Market insights jama karne ka matlab gahakon, muqabileen aur majmooi market ki maloomat jama aur jaanchna hai, ta ke hikmat-e-amli, products aur marketing par soch samajh kar faisle hon.

blocks.prompt: Market insights jama karne ka maqsad kya hai (MCQ 5)? Naye karobar ke liye market research kyun ahem hai (short question 4)?
blocks.explanation: (b) gahakon ki zarooratein aur market ke rujhan samajhna. Naye karobar ka koi record nahi hota, to research batati hai ke log product chahte hain ya nahi, kitna denge, muqabil kaun hain aur kaise mumtaz hon, jis se nakami ka khatra kam hota hai.

items: Market insight: faisle se pehle gahak, muqabil aur market jaanein.
